Rules.InvariantScript:
Switch(
    TemplateServiceCategoryDropdown.Selected.Value,

    "Facilities",
    Table(
        {Value: "Parking Request"},
        {Value: "Locksmith Request"},
        {Value: "Badge Access"},
        {Value: "Space/Office Request"},
        {Value: "Building Maintenance"},
        {Value: "Filtered Water Requests"}
    ),

    "Procurement",
    Table(
        {Value: "Service and Supplies"},
        {Value: "County Business Cards"},
        {Value: "Amazon Purchases"},
        {Value: "Postage"},
        {Value: "Salvage"}
    ),

    Table({Value: ""})
)

If(
    varShowSubmitErrors &&
    TemplateServiceCategoryDropdown.Selected.Value = "Facilities" &&
    TemplateServiceSubcategoryDropdown.Selected.Value = "Building Maintenance" &&
    IsBlank(TemplateRequestTypeDropdown.Selected.Value),
    "Request Type is required.",
    Parent.Error
)

Switch(
    TemplateParkingLocationDropdown.Selected.Value,
    "Civic Center",
    "Civic Center parking is paid and has a waiting list. Your request will be reviewed.",
    "Other parking locations (free)",
    "Parking at this location is free. You do not need to submit a request. No further action is necessary.",
    ""
)
"The requested file could not be downloaded."

Set(varShowSubmitErrors, true);

If(
    IsBlank(TemplateServiceCategoryDropdown.Selected.Value),
    Notify(
        "Please select a Service Category.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),

    IsBlank(TemplateServiceSubcategoryDropdown.Selected.Value),
    Notify(
        "Please select a Service Subcategory.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),

    TemplateServiceCategoryDropdown.Selected.Value = "Facilities" &&
    TemplateServiceSubcategoryDropdown.Selected.Value = "Building Maintenance" &&
    IsBlank(TemplateRequestTypeDropdown.Selected.Value),
    Notify(
        "Please select a Request Type.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),

    SubmitForm(TemplateRequestForm)
)
